title: Airbus: Hydrogen Aircraft Could be Delayed by a Decade
key_claim: Airbus has pushed ZEROe commercial deployment timeline from 2035 to late 2040s, cited slow hydrogen ecosystem development; Destination 2050 hydrogen contribution cut from 20% to 6%.

title: Airbus Slams Brakes on Hydrogen Revolution: ZEROe Aircraft Delayed Until 2040s
key_claim: Independent corroboration of Airbus ZEROe push to 2040s; framing as material strategic retreat from hydrogen aviation.

title: Airbus pushes ZEROe aircraft project timeline to 2040s
key_claim: Trade-press confirmation: ZEROe timeline pushed back 5-10 years; budget cut 25%; A380 flying testbed shut down.

title: Report: Airbus Has Spent $1.7B on Stalled Hydrogen Ambitions
key_claim: Airbus has spent over $1.7 billion on the ZEROe programme to date; sunk-cost evidence of the scale of the retreat.

title: Airbus delays ZEROe hydrogen aircraft research program
key_claim: Confirmation of A380 hydrogen flying-testbed shutdown and 25% hydrogen research budget cut at Airbus.

title: Hydrogen on Hold? Airports Respond to Airbus ZEROe Delay
key_claim: Downstream effect: airports re-evaluating hydrogen refuelling infrastructure planning; capital allocation shifting to SAF and electrification.

title: ZeroAvia: the hydrogen-power innovator aviation firms back
key_claim: ZeroAvia completed financing round December 2025 led by Barclays Climate Ventures, Breakthrough Energy and Horizons; runway extended two years.

title: ZeroAvia targets 2027 certification for hydrogen fuel cell powertrain on Cessna Caravan
key_claim: ZeroAvia targets late 2026 to early 2027 CAA powertrain clearance for Cessna Caravan retrofit, with EU €21.4m grant supporting 15-aircraft Norway deployment from 2028.
